verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API spec. Probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404. The llms.txt index and the markdown reference pages are LLM-friendly documentation, not a formal API specification, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
